case_number: 2023 INSC 608; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. OF 2023 (arising out of S.L.P.(C) No. 26871 of 2019 and S.L.P.(C) No. 27394 of 2019)

parties.respondent: Laxman Maruti Jadhav (Dead) Through LRS and Ors.

summary: Motor accident compensation appeal; claimant's disability (60% medically, 85% under disability act); paraplegia with complete loss of employability despite partial disability; 100% loss of income recognized despite 60/85% disability; no deduction for personal expenses in injury cases; multiplier 18 applied for 19-year-old claimant; Rs.10.8L for attendant charges; Rs.9.72L future medical expenses; Rs.3L for loss of marriage prospects; Rs.3L pain and suffering (enhanced from 1L); deceased's dependents' appeal: salary determination revised with proper pay commission application; multiplier 11 correctly applied.
legal_provisions_cited: Lalan D. v. Oriental Insurance Company Ltd.
Ashivinbhai Jayantilal Modi v. Ramkaran Ram
Sarla Verma v. Delhi Transport Corporation
National Insurance Company Ltd. v. Pranay Sethi
Chaus Tausif Almiya v. Memon Mohammad Umar Anwarbhai
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; compensation enhanced to include Rs.10,80,000 for attendant charges, Rs.9,72,000 future medical expenses, Rs.3,00,000 loss of marriage prospects, Rs.3,00,000 pain and suffering; 100% loss of income recognized; multiplier 18 applied; salary determination to be revised in dependents' appeal; High Court's deductions set aside.
